title: Static launch occupancy-limit prediction
description: Closed-object schema for the per-launch static occupancy-limit prediction artifact emitted by `tools/local_labels/emit_static_occupancy_prediction.py`. Each of the four `launch__occupancy_limit_*` metrics is predicted from the built cubin's static resource usage (cuobjdump -res-usage registers + static shared memory) plus the launch block dimension and the provenance-tracked device-constant table, with no GPU run. Every prediction is exact-or-typed-unavailable: a deferred device constant or a missing resource input yields status `typed_unavailable` with a typed reason rather than a fabricated number. claim_class is `static_predicted` (a forecast, NOT an admitted NCU ground-truth label).

arch.description: Architecture key into the device-constant table (e.g. sm_86).

kernel.description: cuobjdump function name the resource usage was selected from.

block_dim.description: Threads per block (x*y*z) used as the occupancy-calculator input.

registers_per_thread.description: Per-thread register count from cuobjdump -res-usage REG:.

static_shared_bytes.description: Static shared-memory bytes per block from cuobjdump -res-usage SHARED:.

dynamic_shared_bytes.description: Dynamic shared-memory bytes per block supplied by the launch config.

shared_mem_carveout_bytes.description: Configured shared-memory carveout (launch__shared_mem_config_size) used to compute the shared-memory limit exactly. Present only when supplied; absent => launch__occupancy_limit_shared_mem is typed_unavailable.

predictions.description: One prediction record per launch occupancy-limit metric.

value.description: Predicted resident-block limit; null when typed_unavailable.

status.description: available = exact static prediction; typed_unavailable = a needed device constant or resource input was missing.

reason.description: Typed reason string when status is typed_unavailable, else null.

allOf.comment: exact-or-typed-unavailable: an available limit carries an integer value and no reason; a typed_unavailable limit carries a null value and a typed reason.
